_comment: Sentinel acknowledgments - known, HUMAN-VERIFIED external conditions the daily sentinel should report without failing the run. Each entry mutes exactly one (sport, check) pair, where check is 'freshness' or 'coverage', through the 'until' date (inclusive, UTC). An ack is a recorded verification that the data is CORRECTLY thin/stale - not a snooze button: confirm against the source first (WIAA probe commands in docs/operations.md) and say what you verified in 'reason'. Expired and no-longer-firing entries are called out in the sentinel log - delete them when you see those notes.
